name: Docusign MCP
description: Lets agents create, send, and track Docusign envelopes over a hosted OAuth MCP server, including templates, recipients, and signing reminders.

skills.name: Envelope Creation
skills.description: Creates a new envelope from a template with documents, recipients, and tabs through the Docusign MCP server.

skills.name: Envelope Tracking
skills.description: Gets one envelope's status or searches envelopes by date, ID, or status, and lists recipient status and tab values.

skills.name: Envelope Updates
skills.description: Voids envelopes, sends drafts, or changes envelope email, and adds, updates, or removes recipients on an envelope.

skills.name: Signing Reminders
skills.description: Sends reminder notifications to every pending recipient who still needs to sign or act on a Docusign envelope.
